name: Jedidah
title: Mother of King Josiah
summary: Jedidah was the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath and the mother of the righteous King Josiah of Judah. She was married to King Amon. Although she is mentioned only briefly in the Bible, her significance lies in raising one of Judah's most godly kings, who carried out major religious reforms.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Josiah's mother
keyEvents.description: Jedidah is introduced in the Bible as the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath and the mother of King Josiah, who became king at eight years old.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to King Amon
keyEvents.description: Jedidah was married to King Amon of Judah, who reigned for only two years before being killed by his servants.

keyEvents.title: Josiah becomes king as a child
keyEvents.description: After the murder of King Amon, Jedidah's son Josiah was installed as king by the people of the land at just eight years old, suggesting that Jedidah played an important role in his early upbringing.

keyEvents.title: Josiah's Righteous Reign
keyEvents.description: Jedidah's son Josiah walked in the Lord's ways and did not turn to the right or to the left, which may testify to his mother's godly influence.

keyEvents.title: Josiah's Religious Reforms
keyEvents.description: Josiah carried out extensive religious reforms in Judah, including the restoration of the temple and the renewal of the covenant with the Lord, as fruits of a godly upbringing.
